purpose: Track which related-work and reviewer-critical baselines have executable evidence in this repository.

items.claim_boundary: Useful sanity baseline only; beating random does not prove method novelty.

items.description: Structural category or small-first allocation heuristics.
items.claim_boundary: Heuristic ablation, not an external SOTA comparator.

items.description: Consensus allocation compared with budget-matched random seeds on WikiText2/C4 slices.
WikiText2-vs-C4 sensitivity ranking instability across public small model families.
items.claim_boundary: Defines the measured problem setting; not a quality-retention proof by itself.

items.description: At least one practical public PTQ baseline such as AWQ or GPTQ.
items.claim_boundary: Needed before claiming competitiveness against common PTQ practice.

items.description: Rotation/outlier mitigation baseline family such as QuaRot or SpinQuant.
items.claim_boundary: QuaRot/SpinQuant-style proxy coverage is acceptable for related-family coverage; faithful official rotation implementations and activation/KV quality claims still require stronger evidence.

items.description: Recent mixed-precision allocation comparator such as Q-Palette, IMPQ, or WINDQuant.
items.claim_boundary: Q-Palette-style proxy comparator is covered; faithful official Q-Palette/IMPQ/WINDQuant reproductions are still future work.

items.description: Tiny real public-task schema smoke covering GSM8K and MMLU ingestion.
items.claim_boundary: Proves public-schema task ingestion and guarded execution only; not leaderboard-scale retention.

items.description: Task retention beyond PPL, for example MMLU/GSM8K/IFEval/HumanEval/BBH subsets.
items.claim_boundary: A guarded 100-row public MMLU/GSM8K subset is covered; leaderboard-scale retention and fused-model public quality remain missing.

items.description: Measured packed INT4/INT8 kernel evidence on Qwen-like Linear shapes.
items.claim_boundary: Kernel-level evidence only; not end-to-end LLM acceleration.

items.description: On-device Redmi K80 Pro TTFT, tokens/s, peak memory, and thermal or power logs.
items.claim_boundary: No mobile deployment claim until real device logs exist.
